Segments enabled input requires numeric microversion >=1.2; `VMoves.InNotification(ctx, ref)` requires >=1.3. See [segments](segments/README.md), [hosts](hosts/README.md), [notifications](notifications/README.md), [VMoves](vmoves/README.md) for 15 resource operations and [waiting](waiting/README.md) for two proxy waits. ## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.InstanceHAV1(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Segments.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Segments.Resources.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use standard-library `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`. Find treats missing resources as errors by default; `resource.WithIgnoreMissing()` returns `nil, nil`. Delete ignores missing resources by default.
